english_definition: To leave behind or give up completely
chinese_meaning: v. 遺棄、拋棄（家人/寵物）；放棄（權利/信仰/計畫）；中止（任務） / n. 放縱、放任、毫無顧忌
example_sentence: He had to abandon the sinking ship immediately.
derivatives: abandonment (n. 遺棄；放棄；拋棄)；abandoned (adj. 被拋棄的；廢棄的；放蕩的)
synonyms: desert, discard, relinquish, give up, forsake

english_definition: The power or skill to do something
chinese_meaning: n. 能力、才能；專門技能；智力、才幹（常搭配 have the ability to do sth.）
example_sentence: She has remarkable ability in mathematics and physics.
derivatives: able (adj. 有能力的；能幹的)；enable (v. 使能夠；提供機會；授權)；inability (n. 無能；無力；無勝任能力)；disabled (adj. 殘疾的；喪失工作能力的)；disability (n. 殘疾；無能；缺陷)
synonyms: capability, capacity, competence, talent, skill, aptitude

english_definition: Complete, total, and without limitation
chinese_meaning: adj. 絕對的、完全的；無條件的；確鑿無疑的 / n. 絕對真理；絕對原則
example_sentence: I have absolute confidence in your ability to succeed.
derivatives: absolutely (adv. 絕對地；完全地；當然；正是如此)；absoluteness (n. 絕對性；純粹；完全)
synonyms: complete, total, unconditional, definite, unlimited, certain

english_definition: Relating to schools, colleges, or education
chinese_meaning: adj. 學術的；學校教育的；純理論的（不切實際的） / n. 大學教師；學者
example_sentence: The university has very high academic standards.
derivatives: academy (n. 學院；學會；專科院校；研究院)；academically (adv. 學術上；學業表現方面)；academician (n. 院士；學會會員；學者)
synonyms: scholarly, educational, theoretical, intellectual, collegiate

english_definition: To increase in speed or rate
chinese_meaning: v. （使）加速；加快速度；促進（發展）；（車輛）踩油門加速
example_sentence: The car accelerated smoothly onto the open highway.
derivatives: acceleration (n. 加速；加速度；促進)；accelerator (n. 油門踏板；加速裝置；促進劑)
synonyms: speed up, hasten, quicken, expedite, spur
antonyms: decelerate, slow down, delay, retard, brake

english_definition: Able to be agreed on or approved
chinese_meaning: adj. 可接受的；令人滿意的；容許的；差強人意的；受歡迎的
example_sentence: We need to find an acceptable solution for both sides.
derivatives: accept (v. 接受；贊同；承認；承擔（責任）)；acceptance (n. 接受；接納；贊同；錄取)；acceptably (adv. 尚可地；令人滿意地)；unacceptable (adj. 不能接受的；難以容忍的)
synonyms: satisfactory, admissible, tolerable, suitable, adequate

english_definition: To go somewhere with someone as a companion
chinese_meaning: v. 陪伴、陪同（某人）；伴隨發生；為…伴奏（樂器）
example_sentence: Children must be accompanied by an adult in the park.
derivatives: accompaniment (n. 伴奏；伴隨物；佐餐食物)；accompanist (n. 鋼琴伴奏者；樂器伴奏者)；companion (n. 同伴；伴侶；指南手冊)
synonyms: escort, go with, attend, coexist with, back up
antonyms: abandon, leave alone, depart from, desert

english_definition: To achieve or complete something successfully
chinese_meaning: v. 完成（任務/使命）；實現（目標/諾言）；達成（卓越成就）
example_sentence: She accomplished all her goals within two years.
derivatives: accomplishment (n. 成就；造詣；完成；技藝)；accomplished (adj. 有才華的；熟練的；有造詣的)
synonyms: achieve, fulfill, complete, attain, execute, perform
antonyms: fail, give up, neglect, abandon, fall short

english_definition: Correct, exact, and without errors
chinese_meaning: adj. 準確的、精確無誤的；敏銳的；符合客觀事實的
example_sentence: Please provide accurate information on your application.
derivatives: accurately (adv. 精準地；如實地；正確地)；accuracy (n. 準確性；精確度；無差錯)；inaccurate (adj. 不準確的；有誤差的；錯誤的)
synonyms: precise, exact, correct, flawless, spot-on, meticulous

english_definition: To successfully reach a goal through effort
chinese_meaning: v. 實現、達成（理想/目標）；贏得、取得（勝利/聲望/成功）
example_sentence: He worked hard to achieve his dream of becoming a doctor.
derivatives: achievement (n. 成就；達成；壯舉；成績)；achiever (n. 成功者；有抱負的人)；achievable (adj. 可達成的；做得成的)
synonyms: accomplish, attain, realize, reach, gain, secure

english_definition: To accept or admit the truth or existence of
chinese_meaning: v. 承認（屬實或錯誤）；認可（權威/地位）；確認收到（信件/通知）；答謝
example_sentence: He refused to acknowledge that he had made a mistake.
derivatives: acknowledgment (n. 承認；謝忱；收件回執；鳴謝)；acknowledged (adj. 公認的；被廣泛認可的)
synonyms: admit, recognize, accept, concede, grant, confess

english_definition: To buy or obtain an asset or skill
chinese_meaning: v. 獲得、取得（知識/技能/財產）；養成（生活習慣）；收購（公司）
example_sentence: She managed to acquire fluency in three languages.
derivatives: acquisition (n. 收購；習得（語言/技能）；獲得物)；acquisitive (adj. 渴望獲得的；貪婪求得的)
synonyms: obtain, gain, attain, procure, learn, master
antonyms: lose, forfeit, relinquish, give up, surrender

english_definition: To change behavior to suit a new situation
chinese_meaning: v. （使）適應、適合；改編、改寫（小說/劇本）；改造以供新用途
example_sentence: It took him several months to adapt to the new climate.
derivatives: adaptation (n. 適應；改編本；適應性變化)；adaptable (adj. 適應力強的；可改裝的)；adapter (n. 轉接插頭；變壓器；改編者)；adaptive (adj. 適應的；有適應特性的)
synonyms: adjust, accommodate, conform, modify, tailor, fit

english_definition: Satisfactory or acceptable in quality or quantity
chinese_meaning: adj. 足夠的、充分的（數量/品質）；差強人意的；能勝任的
example_sentence: The room was small, but adequate for our basic needs.
derivatives: adequately (adv. 充分地；適當地；足夠好地)；adequacy (n. 足夠；妥善；勝任)；inadequate (adj. 不足的；不稱職的；劣質的)
synonyms: sufficient, enough, satisfactory, ample, competent

english_definition: To alter slightly in order to achieve a result
chinese_meaning: v. 微調、調節（機械/音量/焦距）；調整（心態/作息）；使適應（新環境）
example_sentence: You can adjust the volume using the slider on the screen.
derivatives: adjustment (n. 調整；適應；調節裝置；校正)；adjustable (adj. 可調節的；可伸縮的；可校準的)
synonyms: modify, alter, regulate, fine-tune, adapt, calibrate

english_definition: To respect or warmly approve of someone
chinese_meaning: v. 欽佩、讚賞（品格/勇氣）；欣賞、讚美（風景/藝術）；愛慕
example_sentence: I truly admire her dedication to environmental protection.
derivatives: admiration (n. 欽佩；讚賞；羨慕；愛慕)；admirable (adj. 令人欽佩的；值得讚賞的；極佳的)；admirer (n. 仰慕者；愛慕者；崇拜者)
synonyms: respect, appreciate, praise, applaud, idolize, esteem

english_definition: To legally take another's child as one's own; to choose to follow
chinese_meaning: v. 收養、領養（孤兒/寵物）；採納、採用（新方案/法案/習慣）
example_sentence: The committee decided to adopt the proposed safety policy.
derivatives: adoption (n. 收養；採納；採用；通過)；adopted (adj. 被收養的；採納的)；adoptive (adj. 收養的（父母或家庭）)
synonyms: embrace, accept, take up, approve, foster, assume

english_definition: To move forward or make progress
chinese_meaning: v. 前進、推進；取得進步；預付（款項） / n. 前進；進展；預付款 / adj. 預先的、提前的
example_sentence: Medical technology continues to advance at a rapid pace.
derivatives: advancement (n. 前進；進步；升遷；晉升)；advanced (adj. 先進的；高級的；晚期的；高階的)
synonyms: progress, proceed, develop, move forward, promote
antonyms: retreat, recede, regress, fall back, delay

english_definition: A condition or circumstance that puts one in a favorable position
chinese_meaning: n. 優勢、有利條件；好處、利益（常搭配 take advantage of 利用） / v. 使處於優勢
example_sentence: Speaking multiple languages is a huge advantage in business.
derivatives: advantageous (adj. 有利的；有益的；佔優勢的)；disadvantage (n. 缺點；劣勢；不利條件)；disadvantaged (adj. 處於弱勢的；貧困的)
synonyms: benefit, edge, asset, privilege, lead, merit

english_definition: An unusual and exciting, typically hazardous, experience
chinese_meaning: n. 冒險經歷；奇遇、歷險；驚險刺激的活動 / v. 冒險前往；大膽嘗試
example_sentence: Traveling alone across the mountains was an incredible adventure.
derivatives: adventurous (adj. 大膽創新的；愛冒險的；充滿危險的)；adventurer (n. 冒險家；探險者；投機商人)
synonyms: expedition, quest, venture, exploit, journey
